name: Berserker
source:
One of the two Berserkers that appear in the game; the servant of [url=/c3530]Rani VII[/url]. He is a reckless, emotionless warrior, and holds the qualifications for four other classes: Lancer, Rider, Assassin, and Archer.

[spoiler]His true identity is the Chinese military general Lü Bu. His Noble Phantasm is called God Force.[/spoiler]
